Starship is humanity’s vehicle to Kardashev Type II — a civilization that harnesses the full energy output of the Sun (~3.8 × 10²⁶ watts).

We’re stuck at ~Type 0.7, limited to planetary scraps.

Starship’s full reusability and massive payload enable the launch cadence and tonnage needed for orbital solar arrays, space-based power satellites, and the first steps toward a Dyson swarm.

Without cheap, rapid access to orbit, stellar-scale energy stays sci-fi. 

With Starship, it becomes engineering reality — powering unlimited clean energy, AI, industry, and multi-planetary life.
